name: Pending Settlement Status Reason 2 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for a transfer or settlement instruction settlement pending status.

AWSH.name: Awaiting Shares From Counterparty
AWSH.definition: Securities have not yet been received from the counterparty.

BLOC.name: Account Blocked
BLOC.definition: Your account is blocked, no instruction can settle over the account.

CAIS.name: Awaiting Securities
CAIS.definition: Awaiting securities from corporate action issue or other procedures, for example, conversion, dematerialisation, exchange, registration, stamping, splitting, etc.

CLAC.name: Counterparty Insufficient Securities
CLAC.definition: Insufficient deliverable securities in the counterparty's account, or counterparty does not hold the securities.

DOCC.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From Counterparty
DOCC.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from the counterparty.

DOCY.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From You
DOCY.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from you.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient deliverable securities in your account.

LINK.name: Pending Linked Instruction
LINK.definition: Your instruction is pending settlement because the instruction linked to it is pending.

PHCK.name: Physical Securities Verification
PHCK.definition: Physical shares have been received and are being checked for authenticity.

PHSE.name: Physical Delivery Delay
PHSE.definition: Settlement is physical and securities are being delivered.

SBLO.name: Securities Blocked
SBLO.definition: Settlement is pending. The securities are blocked due to, for example, a corporate action event, re-alignment.

MINF.name: Missing Information
MINF.definition: Information, for example, telephone number, contact person, is missing.

ACOP.name: Account Not Open
ACOP.definition: Account must already be opened in order to process the transfer.

IINV.name: Under Investigation
IINV.definition: Intermediary is investigating the reason why the transfer is pending.

CINV.name: Under Client Investigation
CINV.definition: Client has been informed of a problem and is investigating.

WTRF.name: Awaiting Transfer Agent Status
WTRF.definition: Transfer is being processed by the transfer agent, awaiting status from transfer agent.

ASTA.name: Awaiting Status
ASTA.definition: At your request, the Intermediary is checking the status of your instruction with the transfer agent.

AFST.name: Application Form Sent
AFST.definition: Application form has been sent to the transfer agent.

STST.name: Stock Transfer Form Sent
STST.definition: Stock transfer form has been sent to the counterparty to sign and forward to the transfer agent.

LPRO.name: Longer Processing
LPRO.definition: Longer processing timeframe for this type of transfer, due to documentation requirements.

ADRQ.name: Additional Documents Requested
ADRQ.definition: Additional documents have been requested by the transfer agent.

ADS2.name: Additional Documents Sent 2
ADS2.definition: Upon request of the transfer agent, the intermediary has sent additional documents. The transfer agent has confirmed that all the necessary information is now in place.

DRJC.name: Documents Rejected
DRJC.definition: Documents are rejected by the transfer agent.

CYIN.name: Awaiting Counterparty Receipt
CYIN.definition: Counterparty has not sent an instruction to receive. Check with counterparty.

CYDV.name: Awaiting Counterparty Delivery
CYDV.definition: Counterparty has not sent an instruction to deliver or delivered the shares. Check with counterparty.

OVER.name: Normal Processing Period Lapsed
OVER.definition: Normal processing period for the instruction has lapsed. The transfer agent has been or will be contacted.

SDUT.name: Lack Of Stamp Duty Information
SDUT.definition: Instruction is pending as stamp duty information is missing.

TAPR.name: Transfer Agent Processing
TAPR.definition: Transfer is being processed by transfer agent.

XCNF.name: Expected Confirmation
XCNF.definition: Confirmation is expected from transfer agent.

NRCP.name: Transfer Agent Non Receipt
NRCP.definition: Transfer agent claims non-receipt of physical shares.

FVER.name: Final Verification
FVER.definition: Confirmed but finality is to be verified.
